🎥🎬: Hadestown (Musical)

Hadestown reimagines the Greek myths of Orpheus and Eurydice alongside Hades and Persephone in a world where love, hope, and sacrifice collide. After Eurydice is lured to the industrial underworld of Hadestown by promises of safety and security, Orpheus embarks on a dangerous journey to bring her back.

Guided by the power of music, Orpheus confronts Hades and is given one impossible chance to rescue Eurydice—but only if he can trust her until they both reach the surface. The Tony Award-winning musical blends folk, jazz, and blues into a timeless story about love, faith, and the choices that define us.
